fields.meaning: ward equal to 50% of Max HP; fully regenerates 180 ticks after it last took damage; countered by `counter.ward_breaker`
attack and cast speed × 13000; heals 2% Max HP per second unless `st.unraveled` or `st.shocked`; countered by `counter.disruptor`
immune to `st.staggered` from poise; countered by `counter.staggerer`

fields.effect: heals 1500 Bp of the HP damage it deals
immune to `st.burning`; attack shares scaled by 7000 and `dmg.fire` 3000 added; on death a 3000 mm environmental `dmg.fire` blast of base 15 HP (Canon §10.6)
immune to `st.frozen`; Errata within 4000 mm gain direct `st.chilled` each status pulse
each hit adds 40 `st.shocked` power; on death direct `st.shocked` to every entity within 3000 mm of its origin, its own allies included, in ascending EntityId

each melee hit it takes reflects `min(mul_bp(hp_loss, 2000), mul_bp(B1, 2500))` mHP to the attacker as a `dmg.slash` thorns hit (Canon §10.6, entering at step 3), where `hp_loss` is the HP the hit removed and `B1` is the elite's own ×1 basic-attack `B` (§2.2)
move speed × 13000; `cycle`, windup and recovery × 8000, rounded up with `ceil_div`; a windup never drops below the §1 rule 3 floor of its attack (30 ticks at `dmg_mult_bp ≥ 20000`, 45 at ≥ 40000)
every part's AR × 25000; immune to `st.corroded` buildup; countered by `counter.sunder` (doc 05 §15.1: 5 direct `st.corroded` stacks remove the modifier for 300 ticks)
gains `st.invisible` after 180 ticks without attacking or taking damage
every 600 ticks spawns 2 rank-minion swarmers of its roster, tag `summoned`, at most 4 alive
on death spawns 2 copies at rank minion, tag `summoned`, without modifiers

the first projectile hit it takes in each 240-tick window deals it nothing and instead reflects to the projectile's owner as a Canon §10.6 reflected hit with the projectile's shares and `D2 = min(that hit's D2, mul_bp(B1, 15000))`, no crit

every 240 ticks becomes intangible for 60 ticks (no capsule tests) and blinks up to 6000 mm to the walkable cell nearest the point 3000 mm behind its target (ties lower cell index, no draw) after a 30-tick `marker` telegraph; countered by `counter.anchor` (doc 05 §15.1: no phasing for 300 ticks)
each hit pours 1000 ml of `liq.red_ink` on the target's feet cell (Canon §12.1), at most once per 600 ticks
immune to `st.poisoned`; every 120 ticks emits one saturated cell of `gas.miasma` at its feet cell, `emit_gas_volume(cell, gas.miasma, 1)` (doc 08 §2.7)
every 300 ticks, allies of its faction within 12000 mm gain direct `st.empowered` and +1500 morale
every 360 ticks, after a 45-tick `ring` telegraph, pulls every Erratum within 10000 mm 3000 mm toward itself over 20 ticks
on death, after a 90-tick `circle` telegraph, a 4000 mm `dmg.arcane` blast with `dmg_mult_bp` 30000
